title: Renewal and Retry Settings — Loop+ Membership
content:
Billing reference for the Loop+ Membership renewal settings: the reminder sent ahead of an annual renewal, the retries of a declined renewal charge, whether benefits continue while those retries run, and the window after lapsing within which a buyer may rejoin.

## Settings by plan

| Plan | Reminder before an annual renewal (calendar days) | Retries of a declined renewal charge | Calendar days between retries | Benefits continue during retries | Reactivation window after lapsing (calendar days) | Rejoining within the window keeps the original start date |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Loop+ Access Monthly | not applicable | 3 | 4 | yes | 30 | yes |
| Loop+ Student Monthly | not applicable | 3 | 4 | yes | 30 | yes |
| Loop+ Student Annual | 30 | 3 | 4 | yes | 30 | yes |
| Loop+ Monthly | not applicable | 3 | 4 | yes | 30 | yes |
| Loop+ Annual | 30 | 3 | 4 | yes | 30 | yes |
| Loop+ Household Annual | 30 | 3 | 4 | yes | 30 | yes |

## Definitions

1. **Renewal notice**: the calendar days before an annual renewal that the reminder is sent; not applicable on monthly plans. The three annual plans carry 30 calendar days.
2. **Renewal retry count**: the retries of a declined renewal charge before the membership lapses, a whole number. Every plan carries 3.
3. **Renewal retry interval**: the calendar days between retries of a declined renewal charge, a whole number. Every plan carries 4.
4. **Payment hold benefits**: whether benefits continue while a declined renewal is being retried. Every plan carries yes.
5. **Reactivation window**: the calendar days after lapsing within which the buyer may rejoin keeping tenure, a whole number. Every plan carries 30.
6. **Reactivation keeps tenure**: whether rejoining within the window keeps the original start date for tenure caps. Every plan carries yes.

## Notes

- The renewal reminder exists only on the annual plans (Loop+ Student Annual, Loop+ Annual and Loop+ Household Annual); the monthly plans show not applicable.
- The retry, payment hold and reactivation settings are identical across all six Loop+ Membership plans.
